title: Operator Assignment of an Added Driver, Cardinal Personal Auto Policy Rating Manual
content:
When a driver is added to a Cardinal Personal Auto Policy, the operator share of the driver addition charge follows how the household's rated drivers compare with its scheduled vehicles once the driver is added.

## Rule

| Once the driver is added | Operator share | Rating of the added driver |
|---|---|---|
| More rated drivers than vehicles | 60 percent | Occasional operator |
| As many rated drivers as vehicles | 85 percent | Shares a vehicle as one of its principal operators |
| Fewer rated drivers than vehicles | One | |

## Counting

Both counts are read from the policy's transaction history and include the added driver.

- **Rated drivers.** The drivers added, less those excluded and less those removed. Drivers listed at issue appear as driver addition entries.
- **Vehicles.** The vehicles added less those removed. Vehicles scheduled at issue appear as vehicle addition entries.

## Worked cases (hypothetical)

| Driver additions | Exclusions and driver removals | Vehicle additions | Vehicle removals | Drivers | Vehicles | Share |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 3 | 0 | 2 | 0 | 3 | 2 | 60 percent |
| 3 | 1 | 2 | 0 | 2 | 2 | 85 percent |
| 2 | 0 | 3 | 0 | 2 | 3 | One |
| 3 | 0 | 4 | 1 | 3 | 3 | 85 percent |

Hypothetically, for a full-term charge of 450.00, the operator share of 60 percent comes to 270.00 and 85 percent to 382.50.
